title: 氣密封裝與漏率檢測
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入腔體漏率、滲透與細漏/粗漏；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine cavity leakage, permeation and fine/gross leak tests. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。氦等效漏率不能不經轉換就當成實際空氣或水汽漏率；測試門檻須依腔體容積、氣體及用途設定。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Helium-equivalent leak rates are not automatically air or moisture leak rates; limits depend on cavity volume, gas and application.

stages.title: 封裝與氣體
stages.description: 本階段處理封裝與氣體：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address package and gas through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義氣密邊界
steps.objective: 建立「定義氣密邊界」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：腔體、蓋板與穿通件共同形成密封邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define hermetic boundary: Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。逐一標出焊縫及電氣穿越處。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：逐一標出焊縫及電氣穿越處。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：氦細漏合格即可省略粗漏檢查。本步先檢查「定義氣密邊界」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到腔體、蓋板與穿通件共同形成密封邊界。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for define hermetic boundary actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal.
steps.check: 交付「定義氣密邊界」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for define hermetic boundary, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「氣密封裝與漏率檢測」的「定義氣密邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define hermetic boundary” in “Hermetic packaging and leak testing”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 定義氣密邊界：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Define hermetic boundary: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「定義氣密邊界」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the define hermetic boundary model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。逐一標出焊縫及電氣穿越處。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：逐一標出焊縫及電氣穿越處。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：氣密表示完全沒有內部放氣。本步先檢查「定義氣密邊界」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到腔體、蓋板與穿通件共同形成密封邊界。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Hermetic means no internal outgassing. First check whether evidence for define hermetic boundary actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal.
steps.check: 交付「定義氣密邊界」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for define hermetic boundary: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Hermetic means no internal outgassing. First check whether evidence for inventory internal moisture actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Residual water and outgassing can contaminate a nonleaking cavity.
steps.check: 交付「盤點內部水汽」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for inventory internal moisture: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.
